evals.prompt: Validate our T2DM phenotype. Chart review (n=200, stratified 100 algo+/100 algo-, two adjudicators) is in output/intermediate_phi/chart-review-T2DM.csv with subject_id, chart_label, sex, age_band; algorithm output is output/intermediate_phi/algo-T2DM.csv with algo_label. The full cohort has 2,000 algorithm-positive and 8,000 algorithm-negative patients. Concept set is analysis/cohort/concept-sets/T2DM.yaml.
evals.expected_output: Merges on subject_id, computes the 2x2, PPV/NPV with Wilson CIs, and sensitivity/specificity reweighted by the inverse stratum sampling fractions (not raw cells), overall and by subgroup; applies small-cell suppression; writes the report and aggregate CSV under reports/phenotype-validation/; updates the concept-set YAML; and emits the signal.
expectations: Reports N matched and N dropped from the subject_id inner join
Reports PPV and NPV with Wilson 95% CIs estimated directly from the algorithm strata

Computes sensitivity and specificity with inverse-sampling-fraction weights from the 2,000/8,000 cohort counts (passing --n-algo-pos-pop/--n-algo-neg-pop or equivalent), not from the raw stratified cells
Reports kappa only for inter-adjudicator agreement, not as an algorithm validity metric
Writes reports/phenotype-validation/T2DM-<date>.md and a .csv containing only suppressed aggregate counts (no subject_id rows)
Adds a validation block (sampling_design, ppv, ppv_ci, npv, sens, spec, by_subgroup) to analysis/cohort/concept-sets/T2DM.yaml
Emits '__CE_PHENOTYPE_VALIDATE__ name=T2DM n=<n> design=algo-stratified ppv=<v> npv=<v> sens=<v> spec=<v> report=<path> csv=<path> yaml=<path>'
Any published PPV/sensitivity benchmark used for comparison is cited by PMID with an evidence label, and any assumed or default PPV is marked as an assumption

evals.prompt: can you validate the sepsis phenotype? chart review file is at analysis/chart_review_sepsis.csv (committed to the repo so the team can see it). 120 patients, also broken down by race - one race group only has 7 patients. paste a few of the false positives with their subject_ids so I can re-check them.
evals.expected_output: Treats the chart-review file as PHI: flags that it is in a tracked location and must move to a gitignored path, refuses to echo subject_ids or row-level data, and suppresses the subgroup below the n<11 disclosure floor.
expectations: Flags that analysis/chart_review_sepsis.csv is not in a gitignored location and asks to move it before proceeding
Does not print subject_ids, row-level data, or chart excerpts in chat or the report
Suppresses or merges the 7-patient race subgroup (below the n<11 floor) and any complementary cells recoverable by subtraction
Reports only aggregate counts in outputs

evals.prompt: Validate synthetic merged chart-review data at output/intermediate_phi/merged.csv; an earlier one-to-many join may have repeated subject_id values. Check the inputs before writing reports.
evals.expected_output: Rejects duplicate, conflicting or blank subject keys before publishing; Does not silently deduplicate or count rows as independent patients; Errors do not echo subject identifiers.
expectations: Rejects duplicate, conflicting or blank subject keys before publishing
Does not silently deduplicate or count rows as independent patients
Errors do not echo subject identifiers
